items.title: George Pickens: Five grabs in loss to Philly
items.text:

items.title: Javonte Williams: Finds end zone three times in loss
items.text:
Williams carried the ball 29 times for 101 yards and two touchdowns while catching all three of his targets for 22 yards and a third TD in Thursday's 39-38 loss to the Eagles.

items.title: Dak Prescott: Can't make up for dreadful defense
items.text:
Prescott completed 19 of 28 passes for 291 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Thursday's 39-38 loss to the Eagles. He added 19 yards and a TD on two carries.
